# AI Kamai

AI Kamai sells production-grade AI products to freelancers and solo builders in India. Founded and built by Somil Sharma. Everything sold is live and verifiable — no invented numbers, no fake testimonials.

Store: https://somilsharma2000.github.io/aikamai/

## Products (all live, one-time pricing, UPI, 7-day refund)

- Prompt Vault (₹499): 200 curated AI prompts across 15 categories in a web app (not a PDF) — search, one-tap copy, personalized auto-fill (name/service/niche/city), favorites, lifetime updates. Prompts are written in natural Hinglish so output matches how Indian freelancers actually talk to clients.
- Agency Launch Kit (₹999): complete agency operating system — 7-step playbook, 25 outreach scripts, objection bank, 12-niche client directory, pricing calculator with honest India benchmarks, delivery system, legal basics, 30-day action calendar.
- SaaS Starter Kit (₹4,999): production-ready multi-tenant SaaS codebase — Next.js + TypeScript + Prisma, scrypt auth, UPI checkout with idempotent webhooks, WhatsApp notifications, 17 tests, full docs, 4-minute vertical swap guide. Private repo: somilsharma2000/aikamai-starter-kit.
